title: feat: apply OS2ai brand colour tokens and typography
body: #### Links to issues Closes #48 Closes #49 - LT: https://leantime.itkdev.dk/dashboard/show#/tickets/showTicket/7714 #### Description Applies the OS2ai brand (Figma *Brand - OS2ai*) to the app by retargeting the existing design-token system — colours (#48) and typography (#49). - **Colours**: green primary/accent, charcoal text & neutrals, sand surfaces & borders, replacing the teal/gold palette. Admin tint moves pink → sand. Done as a value remap in the `@theme` block of `assets/styles/app.css`; the ~80 templates consume tokens only via Tailwind utilities, so no template restructuring was needed. - **Typography**: Inter (self-hosted variable woff2) for body and all H1–H6 headings; DM Serif Display (self-hosted) reserved as the opt-in `--font-display` for editorial/hero. Fonts ship from `assets/fonts/` via `@font-face`; the Google Fonts ``/preconnects are removed and the emoji favicon becomes an on-brand green mark. - Email palette constants in `src/Twig/BrandExtension.php` updated so HTML mail (no CSS variables) stays in sync. Primary file: `assets/styles/app.css`. #### Screenshot of the result #### Checklist - [x] My code is covered by test cases. - [x] My code passes our test (all our tests). - [x] My code passes our static analysis suite. - [x] My code passes our continuous integration process. #### Additional comments or questions None. --- # Details - AI specificities ## Goal and motivation The app shipped the old AI Bibliotek prototype look (teal/gold, Fraunces+Geist). This PR makes the real OS2ai identity the app's brand, closing the two Branding token issues. Values come straight from the Figma file `Brand - OS2ai` (key `8SR7HRDrcZ0Ru3YYcubFjm`), read via the Figma MCP. ## Scope / non-goals - In scope: colour role-token values, font families + self-hosting, heading font treatment, favicon, email palette constants. - Out of scope: logo asset integration (#46/#47), the broader asset pipeline beyond fonts (#50 — this PR already self-hosts the fonts), component redesign, dark mode. ## Decisions - **Role-based remap, names unchanged.** The token system was already role-based (`--color-primary`, `--color-text`, `--font-sans`, …) and consumed via utilities, so changing values propagates everywhere automatically. Raw green/charcoal/sand scales are added as reference comments. - `--color-primary` = green-700 `#478523` (AA on white), not the brand-500 `#78C840`, so text/links on white stay accessible. Single green accent per the project's design conventions. - **UI headings use Inter** (Figma uses bold Inter for H1–H6); DM Serif Display is reserved for editorial/hero. `Heading.html.twig` drops `font-display` and carries explicit Inter weights (xl/lg → bold, md/sm → semibold) since Inter needs more weight than the serif to read as a heading. Same `font-display` removal applied to card titles, stat figures, step badges, brand wordmark. - **Fonts self-hosted** from the Fontsource packages `@fontsource-variable/inter` (single variable woff2, weight axis 100–900) and `@fontsource/dm-serif-display` (400). `node_modules` was only a vendoring source — not added to importmap, not committed; only the two woff2 files live under `assets/fonts/`. ## Areas worth scrutiny - AssetMapper CSS `url()` rewriting is used for the first time here — `@font-face` uses `url("../fonts/…woff2")` and AssetMapper digests it. Verified locally: the served CSS references digested font filenames and both woff2 return 200; no Google Fonts request remains. Reference: https://symfony.com/doc/current/frontend/asset_mapper.html#css-files - Contrast: green-700 on white and white on green-700 both pass AA. ## Verification performed - `task assets-build` (Tailwind v4.1.11) compiles cleanly. - `debug:asset-map` lists both woff2; served CSS carries `--color-primary: #478523` / `--color-text: #2c2c2c` and digested font URLs (both 200). - `task coding-standards-check` all green (PHP, Twig, CSS, YAML, Markdown, Composer). - `task test-coverage`: 370 tests pass, 100% coverage.
